skill_name: Generate an essay on the current challenges in the field of [Robotics].
workflow:
Robotics has become an integral part of many industries, from manufacturing to healthcare. Despite the advancements that have been made in this field, robotics continues to present some challenges. 

One of the biggest challenges facing the field of robotics is the lack of autonomy. Robots are unable to detect and respond to their environment in a meaningful way, and so must be controlled and monitored by humans.
